new_en: to date (mark with a date); to date back to; to be outdated
why: Bare 'to date' first reads as romantic dating; French means to put a date on / date back / become dated.
Bare 'tear' first reads as tear/rip (homograph); French means a teardrop.
Bare 'spring' first reads as the season or a water spring; French primary sense is a mechanical coil spring, and 'resort' wrongly suggests a vacation resort vs. jurisdiction.
Bare 'plate' first reads as a dinner plate (that is assiette); French means a flat sheet/slab, license plate, or plaque.

new_en: to draw (water, from a source); to tap into, take from
why: Bare 'to draw' first reads as drawing a picture; French means to draw water / tap from a source.
Bare 'to bore' first reads as boring a hole; French means to make someone bored or to annoy.
Bare 'club' first reads as a nightclub/social/golf club; French means a stick or staff.
Bare 'fine' first reads as the adjective (okay/good); French means a monetary penalty.
Bare 'tank' first reads as a container (water/gas/fish tank); French means an armored military tank or a parade float.
Bare 'lead' first reads as the verb to lead / leadership (homograph); French means the metal lead.
Bare 'watch' first reads as the verb to watch; French means a wristwatch (and, figuratively, display).
